Committee: Ways and Means General Fund
Sponsor: Sanderford
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/23/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 398 as introduced removes the requirement for the State Licensing Board of General Contractors, Onsite Wastewater Board, Board of Respiratory Therapy, and Board of Electrical Contractors to transfer certain funds remaining at year-end from the respective boards to the State General Fund.
For the previous five fiscal years, these boards have transferred approximately $768,000 cumulatively to the State General Fund due to the provisions repealed by this bill.
Steve Clouse, Chair
Ways and Means General Fund
